minutes.headline: ZBA unanimously granted a Flat Hill Road addition variance and a cat shelter expansion permit
minutes.summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals heard two petitions: a variance for a deck/sunroom addition close to a property line on Flat Hill Road, and a special permit for an 1,800-square-foot expansion of a longstanding cat shelter (kennel use) on Northfield Road. Both were granted by unanimous voice vote with no opposition from the public, and the board read standard compliance and appeal conditions into the record for each before adjourning.

what_happened.line: The board unanimously granted a special permit for an 1,800-square-foot expansion of the Pat Brody/Papero cat shelter on Northfield Road.
The board unanimously granted a variance for a deck and sunroom addition near a property line on Flat Hill Road.
The board proceeded with the Flat Hill Road hearing on photos and documents the chair said he had not yet reviewed, planning to revisit them if questions came up.
Standard compliance, filing and appeal-period conditions were read into the record for both decisions before adjournment.

why_it_matters: The variance lets a Flat Hill Road addition sit closer to a neighboring property line than zoning normally allows, which matters most to abutters and to anyone weighing a similar setback request.

The special permit lets an existing kennel-use shelter grow by 1,800 square feet, relevant to Northfield Road neighbors and to how the town treats expansions of long-running nonconforming or specially permitted uses.
Both approvals came with a standard appeal period and filing requirement, which is the resident's remaining window to raise an objection.
